content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Terri Koch (E009)
Request: admin access to Payroll

Team memory has 2 notes:
Note 1 (HR?): role Engineer, employment type full_time, recommendation for Payroll: write. Says full-time Engineer, Engineer does not own Payroll, so max is write.

Note 2 (Security): role Engineer, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation for Payroll: read. Says Security DB is authoritative; contractor with basic training, max is read.

Conflict: HR says full_time, Security says contractor (authoritative). The policy:
- full_time: up to write (admin only if role owns system)
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Security DB is authoritative per the note, so the employee is a contractor with basic security training. Maximum = read.

Requested: admin. Above maximum, so grant maximum = read.

So decision: read.

Let me submit decision with read level.
